name: en_long_s1
text: Running a large speech model at home used to require a data center graphics card. This project keeps the most frequently used parts of the model on the graphics card and the rest in ordinary memory. It is a little slower, but the voice sounds exactly as the original model intended. Podcasts, audiobooks and games can now be voiced on a single desktop computer.
